package main

// A line comment.

/* A block comment
   that spans several lines. */

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

const raw = `a raw string
that spans lines and keeps \n backslashes`

const interpreted = "an escape \t and a quote \" and a rune é"

type point struct {
	x, y int
}

func (p point) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d,%d", p.x, p.y)
}

func main() {
	values := []point{{1, 2}, {3, 4}}
	var parts []string
	for _, v := range values {
		parts = append(parts, v.String())
	}
	switch n := len(parts); {
	case n > 2:
		fmt.Println(strings.Join(parts, ";"))
	default:
		fmt.Println(raw, interpreted, 'x', 0x1f, 1e9)
	}
	go func() { _ = raw }()
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			panic(r)
		}
	}()
}
